licenses_attributions_nuvio_body: Source code and license terms are available in the project repository. Licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
licenses_attributions_tmdb_body: Nuvio uses the TMDB API for movie and TV metadata, artwork, trailers, cast, production details, collections, and recommendations. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
licenses_attributions_trakt_body: Nuvio connects to Trakt for account authentication, watched history, progress sync, library data, ratings, lists, and comments. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.
licenses_attributions_mdblist_body: Nuvio uses MDBList for ratings and external score provider data. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by MDBList.
licenses_attributions_introdb_body: Nuvio uses the IntroDB API for community-provided intro, recap, credits, and preview timestamps used by skip controls. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by IntroDB.
licenses_attributions_imdb_body: Nuvio uses IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets, including title.ratings.tsv.gz, for IMDb ratings and vote counts. Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. IMDb data is for personal and non-commercial use under IMDb terms.
licenses_attributions_exoplayer_body: Used as an Android playback engine. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
licenses_attributions_libmpv_body: Used as an Android playback engine. The libmpv-android wrapper is licensed under the MIT license; mpv/libmpv and bundled native components retain their upstream license terms.

dv7_mode_hdr10_base_layer_desc: Always strip Dolby Vision and play the HEVC HDR10 base layer.
dv7_mode_dv81_libdovi_desc: Convert DV7 to single-layer DV8.1. Requires Dolby Vision display.
dv7_mode_off_desc: Pass DV7 through unmodified. May glitch on hardware that does not support DV Profile 7.
audio_dv5_to_dv81_sub: Signal Profile 5 streams as Profile 8.1 for HDR10-compatible output. Helps on devices that do not have a native DV5 decoder.
audio_dv7_preserve_mapping_sub: Keeps original creator-intended tone-mapping at the cost of slightly more processing per frame.
dv7_libdovi_mode_caption: Conversion mode (auto-selected, do not change unless instructed). Pick one to force it; None uses auto. Active only when DV7 Handling is Convert to DV8.1.
dv7_libdovi_mode_none_sub: No override. Uses the automatically selected conversion mode.
dv7_libdovi_mode_0_sub: Parse the RPU and write it back untouched. No profile conversion.
dv7_libdovi_mode_1_sub: Convert the RPU to be MEL (Minimum Enhancement Layer) compatible.
dv7_libdovi_mode_2_sub: Convert to profile 8.1 with luma and chroma mapping set to no-op. The standard conversion.
dv7_libdovi_mode_3_sub: Convert Profile 5 (DV5) streams to Profile 8.1. Same conversion the Convert DV5 to DV8.1 toggle uses.
audio_mpv_hwdec_dialog_subtitle: Select how libmpv should use hardware decoders.
audio_mpv_hwdec_legacy_direct_copy_desc: Previous default behavior: try direct hardware first, then copy-back.
audio_mpv_hwdec_auto_safe_desc: Safer automatic mode with fallback when some hardware decoders fail.
audio_mpv_hwdec_hardware_copy_desc: Uses hardware decoding with copy-back to software memory.
audio_mpv_hwdec_hardware_direct_desc: Uses direct hardware decoding. Fastest path on compatible devices.
audio_mpv_hwdec_disabled_desc: Disables hardware decoding and uses software decoding only.
audio_decoder_device_only_desc: Only use built-in hardware decoders. Most compatible but may not support all formats.
audio_decoder_prefer_device_desc: Use hardware decoders when available, fall back to FFmpeg. Recommended for most devices.
audio_decoder_prefer_app_desc: Use FFmpeg decoders when available. Better format support but higher CPU usage.
audio_decoder_controls: Controls whether hardware or software (FFmpeg) decoders are used for audio and video

sub_mode_effects_canvas_sub: Animation support using Media3 effects with Canvas rendering.

playback_section_buffer_network_desc: How much content to keep in memory and how to fetch streams.
playback_buffer_custom_sub: Override Media3\'s default buffering with the values below. When off, the player uses Media3\'s stock buffer durations and target size.
playback_buffer_warning: These settings affect buffering behavior. Incorrect values may cause playback issues.
playback_buffer_min_sub: Minimum amount of media to buffer. The player will try to ensure at least this much content is always buffered ahead of the current playback position.
playback_buffer_max_sub: Maximum amount of media to buffer. Must be at least the minimum buffer duration. Higher values use more memory but provide smoother playback on unstable connections.
playback_buffer_initial_sub: How much content must be buffered before playback starts. Lower values start faster but may cause initial stuttering on slow connections.
playback_buffer_after_rebuffer_sub: How much content to buffer after playback stalls due to buffering. Higher values reduce repeated buffering interruptions.
playback_buffer_back_sub: How much already-played content to keep in memory. Enables fast backward seeking without re-downloading. Set to 0 to disable and save memory.
playback_buffer_back_reserve: Reserves ~%1$dMB on top of Target Buffer. Raising Max Buffer Duration shrinks this without losing back-buffer time.
playback_buffer_managed_sub: Caps the buffer to a safe share of this device\'s memory. Turn off to set the Target Buffer Size yourself (advanced — large values can crash low-memory devices).
playback_buffer_target_sub: Maximum RAM used for ahead-buffering. The maximum is calculated from your device\'s available memory (Android\'s per-app heap limit), so higher-RAM devices unlock larger caps automatically.
playback_buffer_target_managed_hint: Managed by the device memory budget. Turn off Managed Memory Budget to set this.
playback_buffer_target_warning: Warning: above device safe limit (%1$d MB). App may crash during playback.
playback_buffer_allow_large_sub: Removes the device-memory cap on the Target Buffer Size slider, allowing values up to 2GB. May crash on devices with less than 2GB of RAM.
playback_cache_vod_sub: Persist downloaded bytes to disk for the current stream. Extends instant seek-back beyond the in-memory back buffer and survives brief network drops. Only applies to progressive streams (no HLS/DASH).
playback_cache_auto_size_sub: When on, the cache is sized from free disk space. Turn off to pick a size manually.
playback_cache_vod_size_sub: Maximum disk usage for progressive VOD cache (LRU-evicted).
playback_cache_info_auto: Auto mode targets about 10% of free space.
playback_cache_info_restart: New cache cap applies after app restart when changing between modes/sizes.
playback_net_custom_sub: Use multiple parallel connections to fetch progressive streams. When off, a single connection is used.
playback_net_parallel_sub: Use multiple connections in parallel for fetching streams. Activate when you experience buffering although your download speed is definitely more than sufficient.
playback_net_connection_count_sub: Number of parallel TCP connections. Higher values increase memory usage and throughput but with diminishing returns.
playback_net_chunk_size_sub: Size of each download chunk per connection. Larger chunks reduce overhead but use more memory.
